info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Creditcard Applications Limits-v5-spec
info.description: The Credit Card Application Limit API provides access to the limits associated with credit card applications. This API allows stakeholders to retrieve the current limits for processing credit card applications, facilitating informed decision-making regarding application submissions. Typical consumers include financial institutions and lending organizations that need to manage application workflows efficiently. By understanding the specified limits, businesses can optimize their credit offerings and enhance customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint retrieves the current application limits enforced by the system. It provides insights into the maximum allowable applications that can be handled, assisting in resource management.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the limit settings for applications. It allows the client to specify parameters necessary for the operation, ensuring the server returns the appropriate limit configuration.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the current application limit.
